patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Intercom documents a broader use-case set; LiveChat is narrower/specialist.

General-purpose vs specialist. Choose LiveChat only if your buying job matches “Established live chat from Text — Starter $19, Team $49, Business $79, Enterprise $52 per ” rather than Intercom's shape. Choose Intercom only if your buying job matches “Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.9” rather than LiveChat's shape. Workflow advantage: LiveChat leans shared coverage; Intercom leans customer-messaging, whatsapp-support. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — Intercom documents a broader use-case set; LiveChat is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: LiveChat is Established live chat from Text — Starter $19, Team $49, Business $79, Enterprise $52 per person/mo annual. Primary live-chat; CS secondary.; Intercom is Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.99/outcome. Primary live-chat; BC + CS secondary..
- Workflow coverage skew: LiveChat-leaning — vs Intercom-leaning customer-messaging, whatsapp-support, contact-center.
- Researched limits: LiveChat — ChatBot, HelpDesk, and KnowledgeBase are separate Text suite purchases; Intercom — Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume.

Limitations — LiveChat: ChatBot, HelpDesk, and KnowledgeBase are separate Text suite purchases; No free plan — trial-only entry; Intercom: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume; SMS, WhatsApp and Phone are pay-as-you-go add-on channels, not unlimited included.

Poor-fit cases: LiveChat is a poor fit when that limitation bites: ChatBot, HelpDesk, and KnowledgeBase are separate Text suite purchases · Intercom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume · Avoid LiveChat if you actually need Intercom's motion (Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
